core.title: Colonial Patriot Door Knocker, Brass Accents A02-K5130-SM

text.description_html:
Brass Accents A02-K5130-SM, Solid Brass Surface Mount Colonial Door Knocker

The Colonial Door Knocker is perfect for traditional homes and comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware. Although this colonial-styled door knocker is suitable for outside use, it is especially great for use on interior doors in apartment buildings.

Brass Accents provides distinctive craftsmanship with old-world tradition for a lifetime of elegance. Their products are hand finished in the USA. They are one of the world's leading crafters of cast-brass and hot-forged decorative brass hardware.

Specifications Colonial Patriot Front Door Knocker:

  • Height: 6"
  • Mounting Centers: 3-5/8"
  • Max Thickness: 3/4"
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Finish: Matte Black

Surface mounted. Screws to the outside of the door with supplied matching finish screws.



** This item is Discontinued. See available Door Knockers.
